name: Kaseifu to Shita
source:
As my wife and I were too busy with our jobs and with no one to watch the kids, I decided to hire a maid.

She was a real beauty. I thought about how to get it on with her. Demanding sex would not go over well. If she were hard to please I'd be stuck in a situation that can't continue. But if played just right, she'd be the perfect woman to do what my wife won't.
